content: Torznab is a standardized RSS2.0-based (XML, some support JSON) query API for torrent indexers, used by Jackett/Prowlarr to normalize disparate indexer sites into one schema (t=search/movie/tvsearch, torznab:attr custom fields for size/seeders/infohash/magneturl). Jackett/Prowlarr act as indexer-proxy layers translating site-specific scraping into this uniform API — the same proxy-and-normalize role this project's backend should play for pluggable indexers.
